create_smolvlm_image_processor: create a SmolVLMImageProcessor instance to preprocess images for the SmolVLM multimodal model
run_image_preprocess_pipeline: run the preprocess method on a batch of images to produce pixel_values and pixel_attention_mask tensors
resize_image_for_vision_encoder: resize an image tensor to multiples of the vision encoder max size while preserving aspect ratio
split_image_into_patches: split a large image into patches of max_image_size and concatenate with the resized original image
pad_images_to_max_dimensions: pad a batch of images to uniform dimensions and return a pixel attention mask indicating valid pixels
